name: hub-home-design-gaps
goal: The signed-in Hub home matches the approved hub-home designs: empty-state panels with next steps, CS initials, counted quota warnings with one almost-out callout, quota dialog status and add-subscription tile, quick replies, phone chat header, counted dialog summaries, weekday headings and plan state pills.

evidence: Side-by-side of 146 built screenshots (hub-home.spec.ts, TAKE_SCREENSHOT) against specification/designs/hub-home/screens on main e6ad8ee083 showed: empty cards drew a currentColor dashed border with no next step; Chief of Staff avatar read CO; Quota card showed bare RUNNING LOW text and repeated Almost out lines; Quota dialog had a generic summary, no per-subscription status, no Add a subscription tile and countdown-only resets; no quick replies; phone chat header stayed Agents; Plans/Scheduled/Projects dialog summaries were generic; schedule days lacked weekdays; plan status chips were not state pills.

hub-home.spec.ts captures screenshots and asserts headings, dialog fit and chat delivery, but never compares copy, empty-state actions, initials, quota counts or dialog summaries with the design, and the empty panel border was never checked against the text colour. New hub-home-design.spec.ts asserts those rendered behaviours in a browser (relations, not CSS strings), and hub-home-presentation.test.ts covers the formatting helpers.
